stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.10 — Method-stratified Future-score Transport, Roux Block-frame Identification & Fresh-vintage Watch Seal

parent.r19_posthoc_localization: CFOP 0.9965966880069477; ZB 0.9883379784794232; Roux 0.5620191598193393. These are design inputs only, not R1.10 results.

intent.primary: Replace the failed all-method future-score transport authority with a prospectively frozen method-family design without modifying the R1.9 phase-objective quotient metric for CFOP/ZB.
intent.secondary: Replace the weak Roux last-face proxy with a state-derived 1x2x3 block-frame identification court before any Roux scoring authority can be considered.
intent.tertiary: After the local transport/frame authority court is sealed, read the current reco.nz index once and issue a watch-only freshness seal. No fresh confirmatory phenotype estimate is authorized in R1.10.

historical_data_role: R1.7 and R1.8 routes remain DEVELOPMENT_AND_CALIBRATION_ONLY. R1.10 does not relabel them as fresh replication.

LAYERED.rationale: Both use the already validated R1.9 cross/F2L/last-layer quotient geometry. Roux is excluded from every LAYERED local and familywise reference distribution.

ROUX.reason: R1.10 is a frame-identification court only for Roux. Even a frame PASS does not authorize future Roux phenotype scoring until a later version freezes and calibrates a Roux-specific metric/null.

layered_scorer.metric_bytes: Reuse R1.9 QUOTIENT_FEATURE_LEDGER amplitudes without changing quotient masks, phase classification, exact-null realization logic, move bins, or observed/reference envelopes.
layered_scorer.local_reference_family_isolation: Every local reference candidate must come from CFOP or ZB only. Roux rows are forbidden in LAYERED training/reference construction.
local_reference_hierarchy: global channel within LAYERED when n>=500
layered_scorer.local_tail: add-one conservative upper-tail probability from exact R1.9 reference_envelope amplitudes; score=-log10(p)
layered_scorer.attempt_statistic: maximum local tail score over all admitted quotient features in one official attempt
layered_scorer.future_bank: Leave-one-attempt-out full-history LAYERED attempt-statistic bank. Each historical bank row excludes that attempt's own features from its local reference. A genuinely fresh attempt is scored against the full sealed LAYERED local reference and compared with this LOO bank.
layered_scorer.familywise_conditioning: Within LAYERED only: method×feature-count-bin if n>=300 -> feature-count-bin if n>=300 -> method if n>=300 -> LAYERED global if n>=1000.

layered_validation_gates.nested_no_test_fold_leak: For outer fold f, test attempts use local references from folds !=f; every familywise-reference attempt in inner fold g is itself scored using features from folds !=f and !=g.

roux_block_frame.representation: A block frame is an ordered pair (bottom_face, first_block_side_face), where the faces are adjacent. The opposite side is the second-block side. Front/back ordering is intentionally quotiented out. This produces exactly 24 physical block frames.
roux_block_frame.first_block_mask: For bottom B and side S: the three S-side edges not incident to top=opposite(B), plus the two corners in intersection(B,S). This is a 1x2x3 cubie block (3 edges + 2 corners).
roux_block_frame.second_block_mask: Same construction using opposite(S) and the same bottom B.
roux_block_frame.state_convention: Every evaluated state is center-canonicalized using the frozen R1.9 24-orientation canonicalizer before block masks are tested.
ordered_frame_evidence: A nonempty annotated ROUX_FB line exists; its endpoint solves the candidate first block and its start does not already solve that block.
A later nonempty annotated ROUX_SB line exists; its endpoint preserves the first block, solves the opposite second block, and its start does not already have both blocks solved.
roux_block_frame.axis_frame_evidence: If ordered FB evidence is absent, an unordered side-axis/bottom frame may be diagnosed from an SB acquisition line, but it is descriptive only and cannot substitute for ordered-frame authority.
roux_block_frame.cmll_consistency: When a nonempty ROUX_CMLL line exists for an admitted frame, both 1x2x3 blocks must remain solved at its endpoint and all corners must be solved under at least one top-face AUF variant.
roux_block_frame.lse_consistency: When ROUX_LSE exists, the admitted block frame must remain compatible with the final solved state; no cognitive interpretation is attached.

fresh_vintage_watch.network_ordering: No current reco.nz read may occur until the R1.10 local method-transport and Roux frame court has committed its authority artifact.
fresh_vintage_watch.watch_action: Read https://reco.nz/solve/ once after local seal; record row count, max ID, exact current ID digest, and IDs greater than or absent from the frozen historical set when that set is available.
fresh_vintage_watch.nonzero_behavior: WATCH_NEW_VINTAGE_DETECTED_ONLY. R1.10 must not score recovery phenotype rates from the new rows.

blocking_falsifiers: Any Roux feature enters a LAYERED local or familywise reference.
Nested outer-fold features influence their own local or familywise-reference score construction.
LAYERED crossfit-vs-LOO absolute score difference p99 exceeds 0.50.
Either nested or LOO pseudo-fresh 1%/5% engineering health band fails.
A purported Roux 1x2x3 block mask does not contain exactly 3 edges and 2 corners.
Ordered Roux frame identification does not meet the frozen support/uniqueness gates.
Fresh network outcomes are read before the local R1.10 authority artifact is committed.
Any gate is weakened after observing its R1.10 result.

allowed: Engineering transport validity or HOLD for the prospectively frozen LAYERED scorer.
State-derived Roux block-frame identification performance and failure modes.
Fresh-vintage watch status after the local seal.
Descriptive historical diagnostics explicitly labelled development/calibration.
prohibited: Cognitive recovery prevalence or cognitive error prevalence.
Intentionality, awareness, strategy-switching, or causal mechanism claims.
Roux future scoring authority in R1.10.
Treating reconstruction annotations as ground-truth latent cognitive phases.
